result.note: Official WPI data for March 2026: tested its composition, the manufacturing weight and the main driver of the rise.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Wholesale Price Index (WPI) based inflation for March 2026:
items: It was the highest reading since January 2023.
Fewer than half of the 22 industrial groups in the manufacturing sub-index posted price increases.
The manufacturing sub-index accounts for over 64% of the WPI.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because 16 of the 22 manufacturing groups posted hikes, led by metals, chemicals and textiles. WPI inflation rose to 3.88% in March 2026 from 2.13% in February, its highest level since January 2023.
questions.source: The manufacturing sub-index, comprising over 64% of the WPI, saw 16 of 22 industrial groups post hikes.

questions.prompt: Which of the following was the main driver of the rise in India's WPI inflation in March 2026?
questions.explain: Mineral oils rose 8.77% and pushed the fuel and power index up 4.13%. Electricity prices fell 5.07%, and food and non-food articles eased month-on-month.
questions.source: The fuel and power index climbed 4.13%, supercharged by an 8.77% spike in mineral oils.
